summary.value: Action + 5 MP: Opposed (INS + WLP) Check (+SL) against an enemy that hears and understands you.

system.description: Action + 5 MP: Opposed (INS + WLP) Check (+SL) against an enemy that hears and understands you. Success: they lose (SL × 5) MP, suffer dazed or shaken (your choice), and all sources deal +(SL) damage to them until your next turn.
